product_metadata.title: OTraki 28 x 45 inch Heavy Duty Laundry Bags 2 Pack Large Drawstring Dirty Clothes Organizer XL Replacement Hamper Liner for Home Dorm Travel Basket Blue
features: USE ATTENTIONS: 1) It's a storage bag, not recommended to used it as a washing bag. 2) It can as basket replacement liner bag, but the hamper preferably with a rounded bottom and less than 17.3 inch in diameter. 3) It is made of thin polyester taffeta, please avoid the sharp object touch the bag surface directly when you put clothes into it.

LARGE CAPACITY - 28 x 45 inch / 70x115cm rectangle laundry bag, enough to hold 3-4 loads of standard-sized laundry, making it ideal for travel storage in college dorms or for family use. When as a liner bag for hamper, can keep hamper stay clean and don't need move it directly.

DRAWSTRING CLOSURE - Heavy duty drawstring closure with spring lock, protect spilling of personal items. Especially when your washing machine is on different floor or buildings, this xl fabric laundry storage bag protect articles from losing in route to washing machine.

MULTI PURPOSES - It's ideal to organize dirty clothes during trip, camp, at home or college. These jumbo laundry bags can be also used to storage quilt, sheets, blankets, bedspreads, and baby kids' toys etc. It is easy to clean, can hand wash and machine washable.

PORTABLE & FOLDABLE - Folding design, easy to storage or carry around. When not in use, it can be fold up easily and sit in a closet to save space. Perfect for camp, hotel and dorm where space is limited! You can even pack it in your suitcase for easy portability.
